affinity.description: One of the thirteen. Use Standard for a weapon whose weapon-lookup `infusable` is false.

max_upgrade.description: The weapon's cap, from weapon-lookup, so an impossible upgrade refuses before the search runs.

starting_class.description: One of the ten. It sets the floor every stat starts from.

target_level.description: The rune level to build to, e.g. 150.

focus.description: What to maximise: 'attack' for total AR, 'spell' for what a named spell hits for out of this catalyst, or a status — bleed, frost, poison, scarlet_rot, sleep, madness. Default 'attack'.

two_hand.description: True if the weapon is held in both hands, which lowers the strength needed. Default false.

vigor.description: Minimum vigor. YOUR judgement, not a computed one — the node spends what is left after this, and the answer must say the floor was chosen.

stat_floors.description: Minimums the rest of the loadout needs: a shield's strength, a second weapon's dexterity, a seal's faith. Real requirements from weapon-lookup or attack-power, not a judgement — the search spends above them.

spell.description: The spell to maximise, exactly as spell-power resolves it. Required when focus is 'spell'; with any other focus it is priced at the chosen spread and reported beside the weapon's figures.
